Pegasus’ production centers on the conflict between a young Black man compelled to reckon with his heritage, and his family’s goals to keep him headed to college.
I loved the ending, and this is all the more reason you should see this production.

cn.t: Critics praise this family drama for its strong performances, particularly Blake Dupree's compelling lead work and Maya Abram's dynamic turn as Mom, bringing depth to Nathan Alan Davis's coming-of-age story about ancestral roots and self-discovery.
